## What changed

Describe the change concisely.

## Why

Explain the problem, requirement, research result, or decision context behind it.

## Related material

Link the relevant Issue, document, requirement, research note, or ADR.

## Change type

- [ ] Project preparation
- [ ] Research
- [ ] Requirements
- [ ] Design proposal
- [ ] Architectural decision
- [ ] Specification
- [ ] Conformance material
- [ ] Documentation or translation
- [ ] Repository infrastructure

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated restructuring.
- [ ] Applicable English and Russian counterparts are updated or the reason is explained.
- [ ] Technical identifiers are consistent across language versions.
- [ ] Sources are primary or authoritative and cited precisely where practical.
- [ ] Added material has a compatible license and clear provenance.
- [ ] Brand assets are handled according to `BRAND_POLICY.md`.
- [ ] No `OPEN` question is presented as accepted without an ADR.
- [ ] The static and passive v0.1 baseline is preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or sensitive vulnerability details are included.
- [ ] Relevant links and rendering have been checked.
